summary: Toronto Parking Authority is carrying out modifications to operations at three (3) of its downtown car parks (Car Park 26 located at 33 Queen Street East, Car Park 36 located at 110 Queen Street West and Car Park 125 located at 323 Richmond Street East). Planned improvements include the replacement of in-lane attendant booths with customer service booths, traffic flow adjustments, installation of pay on foot machines and relocating payment equipment to promote social distancing. Construction of the project is being delivered by Canada Construction Limited, while Our Cool Blue Architects has also been retained to provide engineering design, tender preparation and contract administration services. As a result of changes to the scope and schedule to the construction project, which were driven by delays associated with the Covid-19 pandemic and the discovery of hazardous materials at Car Park 36, amendments to both the construction contract with Canada Construction Limited and the consultant services contract with Our Cool Blue Architects are required. An increase in the value of Purchase Order Number 38191 with Our Cool Blue Architects from $92,939 to $134,814 is being requested due to the extended construction schedule needed to facilitate the asbestos removal at Car Park 36. decided: The Board of Directors of Toronto Parking Authority: 1. Authorized the President, Toronto Parking Authority to increase Purchase Order Number 38191 issued to Our Cool Blue Architects from $92,939, to $134,814, excluding Harmonized Sales Tax. 2. Authorized the President, Toronto Parking Authority to increase the value of Contract TPA5000-245 from $1,576,110, to 1,679,459, excluding Harmonized Sales Tax.
